panels.general_description: Vertical flowchart of lavender boxes, two diamonds and yellow group boxes with arrows.
panels.detailed_description: A top-to-bottom flowchart. Top box: "Patient presents with cardinal sinonasal symptoms: Nasal obstruction, Rhinorrhea, Epistaxis, Nasal itching, Olfactory dysfunction". A diamond "Initial Assessment & Management" branches to a yellow group "GPA Red Flags" (boxes: "Bloody rhinorrhea / Recurrent epistaxis", "Refractory to conventional therapy", "Nasal ulcers / crusting on endoscopy") and, on the left, to a box "Initiate conventional therapy e.g., antibiotics, nasal steroids" (arrow labelled No from the red-flag group). The Yes arrow leads to "Perform Sinus CT Scan", then a diamond about CT features suggestive of GPA whose node text ends with a question mark. Its Yes arrow leads to a yellow group "Suggestive CT Features" ("Patency of the OMC despite sinus opacification", "Mucosal thickening without air-fluid levels", "Concurrent bony destruction and hyperostosis"); its No arrow leads to "Consider alternative diagnoses e.g., invasive fungal sinusitis, malignancy". Then a yellow group "Diagnostic Criteria" (five boxes: "Clinical symptoms & endoscopic findings", "Sinonasal & chest CT features", "Positive c-ANCA/PR3-ANCA serology", "Urinalysis for active sediment", "Biopsy for histopathology if indicated"), then "Multidisciplinary consultation with Rheumatology", "Establish definitive GPA diagnosis" and "Initiate immunosuppressive therapy".
